Practice pages

Pages to try the bookmarklets on, and the pages the test harness runs against. One set, so a page a reader can try is a page a test has already checked.

The pages

  • An article - headings, long text and links.
  • A table - two tables, an image and a column of links.
  • A form - text, a number, a select and a textarea. It sends nothing.
  • A sidebar - a side navigation and anchor links.
  • A video - a player and an embedded frame.
  • A page that keeps loading - a loader that never finishes.
  • A long page - fifty two sections and a scroll offset readout.
  • One of each - a heading, a list, a table, a link and an image, and nothing else.

Nothing here reaches the network

Every page is self-contained: one stylesheet, inline images, and no script beyond the two that fill the long page and show its scroll offset. The harness serves them from an origin of its own, so the clipboard and local storage behave as they would on a real site while nothing is fetched.

Installing a bookmarklet

Each page lists what to try on it. The bookmarklets themselves, and how to install one, are in the repository README.
